dialogues.jp: 「さて、メシメシ……と」
dialogues.en: "Time for lunch..."
dialogues.text: "Time for lunch..."

dialogues.jp: 購買で買ったパンを手に教室へ戻る途中だった。
dialogues.en:
With bought bread in hand, I start to return to the
classroom.
dialogues.text:
With bought bread in hand, I start to return to the
classroom.

dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp:
目の前の廊下を、ころころ転がる何かが横切っ
ていった。
dialogues.en: A tiny little thing rolled past me on the floor.
dialogues.text: A tiny little thing rolled past me on the floor.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「お〜い、どこ行った〜？」
dialogues.en: "Heeeey, where did you go~?"
dialogues.text: "Heeeey, where did you go~?"

dialogues.jp:
続けて、暦先生が。メガネをくいっと上げてい
て、鬼さんこちらのように両手を突き出してい
る。
dialogues.en:
Immediately following it was Koyomi-sensei. She had her
glasses on top of her head, holding our her hands like a
zombie.
dialogues.text:
Immediately following it was Koyomi-sensei. She had her
glasses on top of her head, holding our her hands like a
zombie.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ちっ……メガネがないと見えん……」
dialogues.en: "Damnit... I can't see a thing without my glasses..."
dialogues.text: "Damnit... I can't see a thing without my glasses..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「暦先生、頭、頭」
dialogues.en: "Koyomi-sensei, your head, your head."
dialogues.text: "Koyomi-sensei, your head, your head."

dialogues.jp:
背中から声をかけると、ぴたっと立ち止まった。
その隙に、転がっていった物に追いつく。
dialogues.en:
She immediately stopped as I called to her back. As she put
back her glasses, I chased the rolling thing.
dialogues.text:
She immediately stopped as I called to her back. As she put
back her glasses, I chased the rolling thing.

dialogues.jp: 「あい、どうぞ」
dialogues.en: "Here it is."
dialogues.text: "Here it is."

dialogues.jp: それは、無糖の缶コーヒーだった。
dialogues.en: It was a can of coffee, unsweetened.
dialogues.text: It was a can of coffee, unsweetened.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、どうも」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, thank you."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, thank you."

dialogues.jp:
縁の上下をくいっと挟んで、メガネの位置を直
した。
dialogues.en:
She looked around a bit, then put her glasses back on her
face.
dialogues.text:
She looked around a bit, then put her glasses back on her
face.

dialogues.jp: 「お約束ですねえ、先生」
dialogues.en: "Remember your promise, sensei?"
dialogues.text: "Remember your promise, sensei?"

dialogues.jp:
苦笑しつつコーヒーを渡すと、ぽりぽりと頭を
｛か／掻｝いた。
dialogues.en:
I hand over the canned coffee with a little grin, rubbing my
head a bit.
dialogues.text:
I hand over the canned coffee with a little grin, rubbing my
head a bit.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「最近忘れっぽくてね。いや、かっこの悪いと
　こを見られたな……」
dialogues.en:
"Sorry, I've been forgetful lately. And I've not really been
able to keep up my appearance either..."
dialogues.text:
"Sorry, I've been forgetful lately. And I've not really been
able to keep up my appearance either..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「老化ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Getting on a bit?"
dialogues.text: "Getting on a bit?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あたしは、公私混同はしない主義なんだ。け
　ど、それも時と場合によるしねえ」
dialogues.en:
"I'm not normally one to exert my powers as a civil servant,
but if the time and place is right..."
dialogues.text:
"I'm not normally one to exert my powers as a civil servant,
but if the time and place is right..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「はあ」

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉くぅん。無事、卒業したいよねえ」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun, I hope you go through graduation smoothly."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun, I hope you go through graduation smoothly."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……すみませんでした」
dialogues.en: "...I'm sorry."
dialogues.text: "...I'm sorry."

dialogues.jp: 猫なで声に、白旗を揚げる。
dialogues.en: With the voice of a kitten, I meekly raise the white flag.
dialogues.text: With the voice of a kitten, I meekly raise the white flag.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「分かればよろしい……そうだ、コーヒー拾っ
　てもらったお礼に、何か飲み物でもおごろう
　か？」
dialogues.en:
"Glad we have an understanding. ...That's right, what drink
do you want? I should treat you for getting my coffee back."
dialogues.text:
"Glad we have an understanding. ...That's right, what drink
do you want? I should treat you for getting my coffee back."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「いいんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Is it okay?"
dialogues.text: "Is it okay?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、コーヒーぐらいしかごちそうできない
　けど」
dialogues.en:
"Well, as long as your request involves coffee, it'll be
fine."
dialogues.text:
"Well, as long as your request involves coffee, it'll be
fine."

dialogues.jp: そう言って暦先生がニヤリと笑った。
dialogues.en: Koyomi grinned with her words.
dialogues.text: Koyomi grinned with her words.

dialogues.jp: 「暦先生」
dialogues.en: "Koyomi-sensei."
dialogues.text: "Koyomi-sensei."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Mm?"
dialogues.text: "Mm?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「コーヒーおごってくれるんですよね？」
dialogues.en: "Didn't you invite me here for coffee?"
dialogues.text: "Didn't you invite me here for coffee?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ああ。だからほら、こうしてあたし自ら入れ
　てあげるんじゃないか」
dialogues.en: "Right. What do you think I'm doing here?"
dialogues.text: "Right. What do you think I'm doing here?"

dialogues.jp: そう言って暦先生がポットを指し示した。
dialogues.en: Koyomi pointed to the pot.
dialogues.text: Koyomi pointed to the pot.

dialogues.jp:
その隣に、俺は妙に使い込まれたビーカーを発
見した。
dialogues.en: My eyes caught a beaker sitting right next to it.
dialogues.text: My eyes caught a beaker sitting right next to it.

dialogues.jp:
……なるほど。つまり、コーヒーはビーカーに
入れられて出てくるって訳だな。
dialogues.en:
...I see。 The beaker's probably used as a container to hold
the coffee.
dialogues.text:
...I see。 The beaker's probably used as a container to hold
the coffee.

dialogues.jp:
というか、ここでコーヒーが飲めるんだったら、
わざわざ缶コーヒーを買う意味がわからないん
だが。
dialogues.en:
Although really, if coffee can be made here, I don't see the
point in buying canned coffee.
dialogues.text:
Although really, if coffee can be made here, I don't see the
point in buying canned coffee.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「うん？　ここまで来てコーヒーが飲めないと
　か言うんじゃないだろうね？」
dialogues.en:
"Hm? Didn't you want to come here to have a drink of
coffee?"
dialogues.text:
"Hm? Didn't you want to come here to have a drink of
coffee?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「違いますよ。何でわざわざ缶コーヒーを買っ
　たのかなって思っただけで」
dialogues.en:
"Well, yes. But I thought it would be canned coffee from a
vending machine or something."
dialogues.text:
"Well, yes. But I thought it would be canned coffee from a
vending machine or something."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「たまにはまともなコーヒーが飲みたくなるん
　だよ」
dialogues.en: "It's good to drink normal coffee once in a while."
dialogues.text: "It's good to drink normal coffee once in a while."

dialogues.jp:
つまり、これからごちそうされるコーヒーはま
ともじゃない？
dialogues.en: ...Is she saying this coffee she's brewing isn't...
dialogues.text: ...Is she saying this coffee she's brewing isn't...

dialogues.jp: 「失礼します」
dialogues.en: "Sorry, I have to go!"
dialogues.text: "Sorry, I have to go!"

dialogues.jp:
背を向けて出ていこうとする俺を、暦先生が止
める。
dialogues.en:
I quickly turn to leave, but Koyomi-sensei managed to stop
me before I got to the door.
dialogues.text:
I quickly turn to leave, but Koyomi-sensei managed to stop
me before I got to the door.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「待て、冗談だよ。今入れるから、適当に座っ
　ててよ」
dialogues.en:
"Wait, I'm just joking, sheesh. Just grab a chair and sit
down."
dialogues.text:
"Wait, I'm just joking, sheesh. Just grab a chair and sit
down."

dialogues.jp:
本当に大丈夫なんだろうかと思いながら、俺は
勧められた通り、そこら辺の椅子に座った。
dialogues.en:
Still wondering whether my stomach will really be okay, I
take her advice and sit down on a nearby chair.
dialogues.text:
Still wondering whether my stomach will really be okay, I
take her advice and sit down on a nearby chair.

dialogues.jp:
よっぽどの事がない限り、生物準備室なんて足
を踏み入れないので、何となく物珍しい。
dialogues.en:
I've seen raw food being prepared before, so watching coffee
brew isn't my idea of a good time.
dialogues.text:
I've seen raw food being prepared before, so watching coffee
brew isn't my idea of a good time.

dialogues.jp: 周りをキョロキョロと見ていると。
dialogues.en: I randomly look around the room.
dialogues.text: I randomly look around the room.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「あんまり公私混同はしないようにしてるんだ
　けどね。ほら、あたしには妹が居るでしょ」
dialogues.en:
"Don't make yourself look so conspicious. I do have a sister
in this school."
dialogues.text:
"Don't make yourself look so conspicious. I do have a sister
in this school."

dialogues.jp:
愚痴っぽい口調でもらす。背中を向けているの
で、どういう表情かは分からない。
dialogues.en:
With her back turned to me, she made an idle complaint, with
me being unable to see her expression.
dialogues.text:
With her back turned to me, she made an idle complaint, with
me being unable to see her expression.

dialogues.jp: 「ああ、ことり」
dialogues.en: "Ahh, Kotori."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ん？　おや、何で下の名前で呼んでんの？　
　仲、いいのかね？」
dialogues.en:
"Mm? You're calling her so freely already? You two are that
close, huh?"
dialogues.text:
"Mm? You're calling her so freely already? You two are that
close, huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「いやいや。単に、彼女が気さくなんでしょ」
dialogues.en: "No no. She's just, how you say it... very friendly."
dialogues.text: "No no. She's just, how you say it... very friendly."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「気さく……ねえ」
dialogues.en: "Friendly... huh..."
dialogues.text: "Friendly... huh..."

dialogues.jp: 奥歯に物の挟まったような言い方だった。
dialogues.en: That word seemed to get stuck in between her teeth.
dialogues.text: That word seemed to get stuck in between her teeth.

dialogues.jp: 「何か、疑わしいって顔ですね」
dialogues.en: "What's with that suspicious look?"
dialogues.text: "What's with that suspicious look?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……って、君は背後から顔が見えるのか？」
dialogues.en: "...Are you saying you can see my face through my back?"
dialogues.text: "...Are you saying you can see my face through my back?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、妖怪なんで」
dialogues.en: "Well, for a monster..."
dialogues.text: "Well, for a monster..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……どっちがよ」
dialogues.en: "...Who, hmm?"
dialogues.text: "...Who, hmm?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「もちろん、俺が。それより、ことりの話です
　けど。気さくじゃないんですか？」
dialogues.en:
"Myself, of course. Anyway, about Kotori. You don't think
she's friendly?"
dialogues.text:
"Myself, of course. Anyway, about Kotori. You don't think
she's friendly?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「う〜ん、どうだろうねえ」
dialogues.en: "Hummm, I wonder."
dialogues.text: "Hummm, I wonder."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ほい、入ったよ」
dialogues.en: "Watch it, here it comes."
dialogues.text: "Watch it, here it comes."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ども」
dialogues.en: "Ah, thank you."
dialogues.text: "Ah, thank you."

dialogues.jp:
ビーカーではなかった。香ばしい湯気が立ち上
るカップを受け取る。
dialogues.en:
It wasn't a beaker, but a fragrant cup with steam rising
from it that was handed to me.
dialogues.text:
It wasn't a beaker, but a fragrant cup with steam rising
from it that was handed to me.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ことりね……確かに人当たりはいいんだけど、
　どうも無理してるように見えるんだよね。姉
　から見てさ」
dialogues.en:
"Kotori... she's definitely a socialable person, but she
always seems like she's overdoing it. From what I see,
anyway.
dialogues.text:
"Kotori... she's definitely a socialable person, but she
always seems like she's overdoing it. From what I see,
anyway.

dialogues.jp:
暦先生がさっき転がしてしまった缶のプルトッ
プを開け、中身をぐびりとやる。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei opened the previously-rolling canned coffee
using the pull-top, and took a drink from it.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei opened the previously-rolling canned coffee
using the pull-top, and took a drink from it.

dialogues.en: "Ehhh..."
dialogues.text: "Ehhh..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「ま、朝倉でも誰でも、仲良くしている人が居
　るんなら、あたしは言うことはないけどね」
dialogues.en:
"Well, whether you or anyone else, if she wants to make
friends with them, there's nothing I can say about it."
dialogues.text:
"Well, whether you or anyone else, if she wants to make
friends with them, there's nothing I can say about it."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「俺は誰でも扱いですか」
dialogues.en: "Would I be an "anyone else" as well?"
dialogues.text: "Would I be an "anyone else" as well?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「いやあ……」
暦先生は、ニヤリと笑った。
dialogues.en: Koyomi started grinning.
dialogues.text: Koyomi started grinning.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「別に、ワンオブゼムじゃなくなるんなら、そ
　れはそれで結構な事だけど」
dialogues.en:
"I wouldn't consider you just "one of them". You should be
happy for that."
dialogues.text:
"I wouldn't consider you just "one of them". You should be
happy for that."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「んな事言って、もしことりがどっかに嫁ぐ事
　になったら、きっと大泣きするんでしょ」
dialogues.en:
"Both ways, she's so popular that if she were to marry, I
bet there'd be an unofficial day of mourning for this
island."
dialogues.text:
"Both ways, she's so popular that if she were to marry, I
bet there'd be an unofficial day of mourning for this
island."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……かもね」
dialogues.en: "...Probably."
dialogues.text: "...Probably."

dialogues.jp: ◆暦先生とことり◆
dialogues.en: ◆Koyomi-sensei and Kotori◆
dialogues.text: ◆Koyomi-sensei and Kotori◆

dialogues.jp:
暦先生に会い、ひょんな事から、コーヒーをご
ちそうになった。
dialogues.en:
I bumped into Koyomi-sensei, and somehow or other, she ended
up treating me to some coffee.
dialogues.text:
I bumped into Koyomi-sensei, and somehow or other, she ended
up treating me to some coffee.

dialogues.jp:
公私混同がどうのという話から、先生の妹──
ことりについて話が及んだ。
dialogues.en:
From talking about private and public matters, the subject
of her sister came up.
dialogues.text:
From talking about private and public matters, the subject
of her sister came up.

dialogues.jp:
先生は、ことりが気さくなのかどうなのか、歯
切れが悪かったが……。一体、何なんだろうな。
dialogues.en:
Apparently, Kotori mixing around so well gives her something
of a bad feeling... I wonder why.
dialogues.text:
Apparently, Kotori mixing around so well gives her something
of a bad feeling... I wonder why.
